A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 23-page versions of GEO-Bench-2. The main text, tables, figures, and Appendix 6 can be matched reliably, including renumbered appendix figures.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations of 14 models across 19 dataset/task entries, with rankings, performance plots, and eight ablations in Section 4 and Appendix 6.3.

after.justification: v2 retains the original model evaluations, rankings, per-dataset results, and ablation outcomes in Section 4 and Appendix 6.3.

M1.justification: The capability-based benchmark and model-adaptation procedures remain unchanged, including classification heads, UNet decoding, detection frameworks, and temporal feature averaging. The optimizer specification revision concerns experimental settings rather than a new proposed method component.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 19 dataset/task entries and nine capability groups. Revised split counts and newly documented timestamp counts do not establish added datasets, tasks, or test scenarios.

E2.justification: The 14 evaluated models in Tables 1 and 4 are unchanged. Corresponding appendix experiments retain the same comparator subsets; no comparison method is added or removed.

E3.justification: Table 2 substantially revises five reported train/validation/test counts, all previously 4000/1000/2000: BioMassters becomes 4011/1739/2776, CloudSen12 4000/535/975, Dynamic EarthNet 700/100/200, FLAIR 2 4049/1022/3022, and SpaceNet2 5186/1461/2961. Section 2.1 changes the pixel-wise/detection subsampling limit from 4000 to 5000, adding a BioMassters exception. Appendix 6.2 specifies AdamW instead of Adam. These materially revise reported settings without establishing that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: Appendices 6.3.2–6.3.9 retain the same ablations covering encoder freezing, decoder complexity, spectral inputs, spatial resolution, modalities, timestamps, cosine annealing, and warm-up. Their evidence and findings are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report five repeated seeds, 100 bootstrap resamples for IQM aggregation, 2000 bootstrap resamples for ranking uncertainty, and the same paired t-test and Cohen's D analyses.

E6.justification: Table 1 rankings and all corresponding performance plots are unchanged, including the main raw results in v1 Figure 24/v2 Figure 25 and subsequent ablation plots. Table 2 changes concern sample counts, not performance outcomes.

T1.justification: Capability definitions and normalization, bootstrap, and IQM descriptions are retained. No theorem, proof, or mathematical derivation is added or revised; the new RMSE-conversion note supplies no formula.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction retain the same benchmark contributions and claims: no model dominates universally, natural-image models remain competitive, and EO-specific models offer advantages on multispectral applications.

C2.justification: The interpretations of architectural, spectral, temporal, and adaptation effects are unchanged. Section 5.1 retains the same limitations concerning untested models, geographic imbalance, the missing SAR-specific capability, and unassessed predictive uncertainty.

D1.justification: Appendix 6.2 newly specifies seven timestamps for BioMassters and PASTIS, two pre/post-flood timestamps for KuroSiwo, and six weekly timestamps for Dynamic EarthNet. It also explains that BioMassters RMSE is converted to a higher-is-better score using a leaderboard utility. These disclose details of retained experiments; the conversion formula is not provided in the PDF.

R1.justification: The same 66 references and research positioning are retained, including comparisons with GEO-Bench, PANGAEA, natural-image pretraining, and specialized geospatial models.

P1.justification: The manuscript is largely verbatim. Local edits expand the experimental description, correct Alexander Lacoste to Alexandre Lacoste, update his affiliation, add Paolo Fraccaro's corresponding-author marker, and update figure references. The section structure is retained.

P2.justification: The Forestnet example figure is resized and appendix text reflows around retained plots. Figures 23–40 become Figures 24–41 without adding a figure. Table structures and the substantive graphical displays remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves reproducibility by documenting dataset-specific timestamp counts and explaining the previously unexplained higher-is-better BioMassters score. It also revises sample counts and the optimizer specification. The empirical evidence and conclusions remain unchanged, the PDFs do not establish reruns, and the score-conversion formula remains unspecified locally, limiting the gain.
